            .git_ignore(true)
            .git_global(false)

                let name = entry.file_name().to_string_lossy();
                !matches!(
                    name.as_ref(),
                    "node_modules"
                        | ".git"
                        | "target"
                        | "dist"
                        | "build"
                        | ".next"
                        | "__pycache__"
                        | ".venv"
                        | "venv"
                        | "coverage"
                        | ".cache"
                        | ".idea"
                        | ".vscode"
                )
            })
            .build()
            .filter_map(|e| e.ok())
            .filter(|e| e.file_type().is_some_and(|ft| ft.is_file()))

            }).for_each
